title: Regularity of the Mod-Two Inner-Product Indicator
statement: For every natural number $m$, define a function on $\{\pm1\}^{2m}$ by decoding the coordinates into two vectors $a,b\in\mathbb F_2^m$ and returning the indicator of $\sum_{i=1}^m a_i b_i=1$ in $\mathbb F_2$. Every Fourier coefficient indexed by a nonempty coordinate set has absolute value at most $2^{-(m+1)}$.
